    4: (0, 2, 400, [16, 10]),
    5: (1, 3, 500, [17, 15, 12]),
}

z = {}   # z[i,k] = 1 if store type i has k stores
n = {}
for i, (lo, hi, a, p) in data.items():
    for k in range(lo, hi + 1):
        z[i, k] = pulp.LpVariable(f"z_{i}_{k}", cat="Binary")
    prob += pulp.lpSum(z[i, k] for k in range(lo, hi + 1)) == 1

# area constraint
prob += pulp.lpSum(data[i][2] * n[i] for i in data) <= 5000

    k * data[i][3][k - data[i][0]] * z[i, k]
    for i in data
    for k in range(data[i][0], data[i][1] + 1)
)

# rent = 20% of profit
prob += 0.2 * profit

prob.solve(pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=False, timeLimit=60))
print(f"STATUS={pulp.LpStatus[prob.status]} OBJECTIVE={pulp.value(prob.objective)}")

     for i in range(n) for p in range(n)}

     for i, p, j, q in itertools.product(range(n), repeat=4)}

    prob += pulp.lpSum(x[i, p] for p in range(n)) == 1

for p in range(n):
    prob += pulp.lpSum(x[i, p] for i in range(n)) == 1

# linearization constraints
for i, p, j, q in itertools.product(range(n), repeat=4):

    prob += y[i, p, j, q] <= x[j, q]

import pulp

def solve(a, k):
    n = len(a)
    prob = pulp.LpProblem("fighter_allocation", pulp.LpMaximize)
    x = [pulp.LpVariable(f"x_{j}", lowBound=0) for j in range(n)]  # combat jets
    y = [pulp.LpVariable(f"y_{j}", lowBound=0) for j in range(n)]  # training jets

    for j in range(n):
        prob += x[j] + y[j] == a[j]

    for j in range(n):
        prob += x[j] <= k * pulp.lpSum(y[i] for i in range(j))
    prob += pulp.lpSum(x)
    prob.solve(pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=False, timeLimit=60))
    print(f"STATUS={pulp.LpStatus[prob.status]} OBJECTIVE={pulp.value(prob.objective)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":

prob = pulp.LpProblem("machines", pulp.LpMinimize)
x = pulp.LpVariable("x", cat="Integer")  # machines A
y = pulp.LpVariable("y", cat="Integer")  # machines B

prob += x + y
prob += 30 * x + 50 * y >= 1000
prob += 100 * x + 120 * y <= 3000
prob += y <= 0.3 * (x + y)
prob += x >= 5

prob.solve(pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=False, timeLimit=60))
print(f"STATUS={pulp.LpStatus[prob.status]} OBJECTIVE={pulp.value(prob.objective)}")
